description: Search Google Jobs for `<query>` — returns title, company, location, source, posted date, schedule, description, and apply link via SerpApi. Example: serpapi_google_jobs({ q: "data engineer", location: "Austin, TX", _apiKey: "your-serpapi-key" })

_apiKey.description: SerpApi API key (get one at serpapi.com)

location.description: Optional location, e.g. "Austin, TX", "London, United Kingdom"

q.description: Job search query, e.g. "data engineer", "barista part time"

name: serpapi_google_jobs
title: Serpapi Google Jobs
